data.one_liner: A Flutter package to create a draggable floating ball similar to AssistiveTouch.
data.what_it_does: Provides a Dragball widget that can be placed on top of a Scaffold to create a floating, draggable element similar to iPhone's AssistiveTouch or floating UI components. It supports taps, position changes, and custom child widgets.
use_when: You need a floating, draggable button or ball overlay on top of your app screens.
You want to replicate an AssistiveTouch or floating shortcut menu style.
avoid_when: You need a complex state management or navigation system.
You are looking for core Dart utilities or non-UI features.
strengths: Easy to integrate by placing on top of the Scaffold.
Supports custom ball widgets, initial positions, and position change callbacks.
weaknesses: Specific to a single floating ball UI pattern.
data.setup_notes: Put DragBall on top of the Scaffold as documented in the README.
